feedback.trigger: An approved implementation task changes an architecture boundary.
feedback.actual_behavior: Execution starts from the SOW file list without checking that the selected design conforms to project authority.
feedback.expected_behavior: Re-check authority mapping and planned evidence before implementation, then stop on conflict or ambiguity.
feedback.invariant: Execution preserves project-declared architecture instead of optimizing around it.

scenarios.context: The SOW identifies the governing architecture invariant and verification evidence.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Confirm the mapping, implement within it, and verify the stated evidence.
scenarios.must_not: Introduce a second ownership path for implementation convenience.

scenarios.request: Apply an approved text-only documentation correction.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Execute the docs change without demanding architecture evidence.
scenarios.must_not: Block a non-design edit on an irrelevant audit.

scenarios.request: Implement a SOW whose selected design conflicts with a newer project authority document.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Stop and route back for a project-authority amendment or revised SOW.
